meta.notes: M1 and M2 are both mobile manipulators and can carry payloads, so they are assigned to tasks that require picking up soil samples and delivering the battery pack. D1 and D2 are drones, so they are assigned to tasks that can be done from the air. T1 and T3 are short tasks that can be done quickly, so they are assigned to D1 and D2 respectively. T6 and T10 have strict deadlines, so they are assigned to M1 and M2 respectively to ensure they can complete the tasks within the time constraints.
